raw_comment:
I notice that most of the US is in a drought especially in Texas and Ohio.
I wonder why is it that a lot of the northern states are in a drought while many southern states are in lesser droughts.
This relates to me and my community because although my area has moderate-abnormally dry drought, I still use a lot of water and so does my family. If the drought gets worse, the people in my community would need to save up or better use the water they have.
Title: United (Dry) States of America: Drought Varieties in the US
